reset: Opt-in watch --reset-state archives .tcfcomic under a collision-safe backup name in destination. Never recursively delete. Preserve sources/output/quarantine evidence. Refuse active destination. Wait existing request/429 cooldown interruptibly before reset, so new history cannot bypass rate limiting.
compatibility: Keep legacy single-prompt YAML and existing queue format working unchanged. Do not upgrade old database. Fresh named-prompt state supports variant-qualified uniqueness. If config/state modes disagree, fail clearly and leave state unchanged.
configuration: provider.prompts is an ordered mapping of safe unique names to prompt text, mutually exclusive with provider.prompt. Update only active interactive config; preserve its current first prompt exactly.
processing: Independent original-image input and per-variant durable jobs; no chaining. Both share destination lock, queue and provider rate/cooldown gate. One successful variant is never replayed because the other fails.
output: Named-prompt filenames contain the variant name and retain collision-safe publication. Legacy filename contract unchanged. Multi-prompt one-shot prints each successful output path; exit is nonzero if any requested variant fails.
privacy: No prompts, credentials, image bytes or metadata in logs. No real data used as test fixtures.
phaseStatus: Only coding and tests active. Other gates paused, not passed.
